fuel_dump._doc: U10 §3 Act III (T-157): Groom Lake's fuel dump (gravelight/world/map04/trap_fuel_dump.gd): a 1 s hiss, the whump, a wall of fire for duration s; zombies that touch it die (zombie_damage, like the live wire), a player in it takes player_dps; the smoke column lingers smoke_linger_s.

door_drop._doc: U10 §3 Act III (T-157): the hangar's door drop (gravelight/world/map04/trap_door_drop.gd): a 1 s scream of the rollers (players in the doorway are shoved clear), the door falls and crushes the zombies in the doorway, stays down duration s, winches up; cooldown s.
